The system shall allow users to reset their forgotten password via email.

Requirements:
1. User enters their registered email address on the forgot password page
2. System sends a password reset link valid for 1 hour
3. The reset link contains a unique token
4. User clicks the link and enters a new password
5. New password must meet complexity requirements (8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, digit)
6. Old password is invalidated after reset
7. User receives confirmation email after successful reset
